en.name: Machida City Museum of Graphic Arts
en.description: Machida City Museum of Graphic Arts is a premier attraction in Tokyo, offering authentic local culture and unique architectural views. Visitors can explore historic surroundings and enjoy seasonal events throughout the year.
en.notes: Check current special exhibition schedules and arrive 15 minutes before opening.
en.reservation: Online advance ticket reservation recommended on weekends.
